messages:
Zara: following the postmortem, here's a concise action map for recurring paging patterns and owners. attaching the CSV of top noisy rules. link: https://internal.redwood/actions/noise-csv :file_folder:
Luis: thanks. quick ask  can we prioritize items that have >30 pages/week and >30% duplicates? that's where we'll get the most bang for effort.
Zara: agreed. prioritized list: 1) kvcache-flap, 2) auth-db-timeout, 3) model-infer-oom, 4) api-rate-flood. owners assigned inline.
Ben: I'll take api-rate-flood. plan: implement a sliding-window rate gate + transient suppression for identical caller-id. ETA: canary in 48h.
Zara: for kvcache-flap we're recommending dedupe + threshold buckets. proposal snippet from analysis:
```
# kvcache dedupe proposal (pseudo)
policy: kvcache-noise-2026-04
group_by: request_path
window: 180s
max_pages: 1
allow_urgent_if: error_rate > 0.25
```
Zara: Ben/Luis please review safety gate: we must not suppress if error_rate high.
Luis: I'll own auth-db-timeout. plan: move threshold from 95th to 99.5th pctl and add a 3m hysteresis. also add a non-pager soft-alert to collect context before paging.
Ben: started a canary branch `noise/dedupe-api` and will roll to canary region. will post logs.
pager-bot: Created INF-5010 "api-rate-flood dedupe canary" assigned to Ben, due 2026-04-05.
Zara: monitoring rules to add: suppression_rate, missed_alert_estimate, and suppression_impact (pages avoided). need dashboard tiles + slack webhook.
Luis: safety rollback metric idea: if `missed_alert_estimate >= 0.01 for 30m` -> immediate rollback + page infra-oncall.
ops-bot: Linked PM-2026-04 to INF-5010, INF-5011.
Ben: initial canary numbers: suppression_rate=0.46, missed_alert_estimate=0.003. running synthetic load for 3h, will report after.
Zara: timeline recap: Ben canary in 48h, Luis thresholds PR by Fri, Zara will own runbook + postmortem action tracker updates by EOD tomorrow. weekly follow-up slot set for Mon 09:30 20m.
Luis: one more thing: add service-owner on-call as a notify target when suppression is active so they can manually override if needed.
Zara: done. I've updated the action sheet with owners, timelines, and rollback steps. ping me for blockers. :white_check_mark:
